content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail, digital creators face an insurmountable barrier. You need an effective solution to set up a reliable crypto store quickly and easily. Cloudflare Pages provides a robust option for those in countries like Nigeria and Ghana that experience [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-trap-most-creators|The Payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-my-unfiltered-take-3|payment]] processing restrictions. This guide will walk you through the necessary steps to build your own crypto store using the Edge Commerce Stack, ensuring you retain full ownership and control over your digital products.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The critical [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-solutions-when-stripe-paypal-13|COREMERCH guide to difference]] between traditional platforms and the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH lies in ownership and sovereignty. When you build your store on Cloudflare Pages, you bypass the bureaucratic restrictions imposed by payment processors. Instead, you leverage a decentralized approach that uses crypto payments through NOWPayments, which allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This autonomy ensures that you have full control over your income streams without dependence on external services that may impose fees or limits.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before embarking on your Cloudflare Pages deployment, ensure you have the necessary components ready. You'll need a Cloudflare account to host your site, familiarity with Google Apps Script for backend logic, and an understanding of NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Make sure you have your digital products ready for upload, as this will be critical during the deployment process. Lastly, review the Sovereign Blueprint for a comprehensive guide on what to expect during your setup and operation.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery systems, first integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages setup. Configure your payment settings to accept desired cryptocurrencies and set your webhook for automatic confirmation of transactions. You'll then implement Google Apps Script to handle order processing and delivery of digital products, ensuring immediate access once a payment is confirmed. This streamlined pipeline not only enhances user experience but also secures your revenue with automatic delivery, eliminating delays.
Full ownership of your store means no platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it's time to go live. Ensure that your payment integration is functioning correctly by testing it in a controlled environment. Once confirmed, promote your store using channels that resonate with your audience. Direct traffic to your URL, like https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, and encourage potential customers to make their first purchase. Monitor the transaction process closely to address any issues promptly and verify that your automated delivery system is working seamlessly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After achieving a successful launch, the focus shifts to scaling your operations. Leverage the additional features provided in the Edge Commerce Stack, such as configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC for your email communications, to enhance your brand's credibility. Consider adding more products to your store to increase your revenue potential. Regularly review your traffic and sales analytics to identify growth opportunities, and optimize your marketing strategies to drive more conversions.

Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for a detailed setup guide. This allows you to maintain full ownership and control over your online sales without relying on restricted platforms.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees.

For those looking to further enhance their store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack for added features and faster deployment. This stack ensures your store is fully configured and tested before going live, making it an excellent option for serious creators. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
